Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ke tilak samaroh men kaee VIP mehman pahunche. Mokama ke Ladma sthit unke aavas par mehmanon ka khas andaj men svagat kiya gaya. samaroh men pahunche mehmanon ki tasviren samne aaee hain. dekhie tilak samaroh ki khas jhalkiyan.
